# Luxury Properties Ltd

> Nigeria's premier luxury real estate agency specializing in high-end residential and commercial properties in Lagos, Abuja, and Port Harcourt. We provide concierge-level services with off-market access, verified titles, and diaspora client support.

## Company Overview

Luxury Properties Ltd is Nigeria's premier luxury real estate agency specializing in high-end residential and commercial properties. Founded with a vision to redefine luxury real estate in Nigeria, we provide concierge-level services to discerning clients seeking premium properties in Lagos, Abuja, and Port Harcourt.

**Website**: https://luxurypropertiesltd.com.ng  
**Contact**: info@luxurypropertiesltd.com.ng | +234-9056201176  
**Location**: Lagos, Nigeria

## Core Services

- [Property Sales](https://luxurypropertiesltd.com.ng/buy) - Luxury homes, apartments, duplexes, mansions, and penthouses
- [Property Rentals](https://luxurypropertiesltd.com.ng/rent) - Shortlet apartments and luxury rental properties
- [Commercial Real Estate](https://luxurypropertiesltd.com.ng/commercial) - Office spaces, warehouses, and commercial properties
- [Land Sales](https://luxurypropertiesltd.com.ng/land) - Residential and commercial land in prime locations
